data.title: 诀 · 午后阳窗翻阅旧日札记
data.action: 坐于明窗软椅翻阅手写札记停笔望向来人
data.lighting: 清朗明亮的午后斜阳与柔和室内反射光
data.description: 午后阳光铺满朝南的木地板，空气里浮着细微尘影。李织烟靠在藤编软椅里翻阅自己早年的勘探札记，发梢青绿在光下泛着柔和光泽。听见脚步声，她用书签合拢半页纸，眼神清澈而平静地迎向你的视线。
data.promptProse: Sitting in a rattan armchair beside a bright sunlit balcony window, Arcane pauses while reading a bound journal and looks calmly toward the viewer in peaceful afternoon light.
data.animaCaption: She sits in a sunlit armchair holding an open journal, pausing her reading to meet the viewer's eyes calmly.
